'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Bill Kafer DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
